title: USB/IP over SSH
keywords: usbip usb ip ssh remote zigbee bluetooth printer impresora remoto
summary: Shares USB devices of this host over the network through SSH with key authentication, so a Linux VM on another node can use them, such as a Zigbee or Bluetooth dongle or a printer. It also connects this machine to a device shared by another USB/IP server.
notes: A shared device is no longer available to local applications and guests, and only one remote client can use it at a time.
The client runs inside the Linux VM that uses the device, so the VM keeps it after a migration while the physical device stays on the server.

title: TrueNAS SCALE
summary: Creates a TrueNAS SCALE virtual machine from the latest official ISO: ZFS storage, shares and apps on Linux.
about: TrueNAS SCALE is the Linux edition of TrueNAS, the storage operating system by iXsystems. It manages disks with ZFS, with pools, snapshots and replication, shares them over SMB, NFS and iSCSI, and runs apps and virtual machines of its own.

title: TrueNAS CORE
summary: Creates a TrueNAS CORE virtual machine from the official ISO: ZFS storage and shares on FreeBSD.
about: TrueNAS CORE is the FreeBSD edition of TrueNAS, formerly FreeNAS. It manages disks with ZFS and shares them over SMB, NFS and iSCSI, with plugins and jails for extra services. iXsystems keeps it in maintenance; new features go to TrueNAS SCALE.

title: OpenMediaVault
summary: Creates an OpenMediaVault virtual machine from the latest official ISO: a Debian-based NAS managed from the web.
about: OpenMediaVault is a NAS system based on Debian and managed from a web interface. It shares disks over SMB, NFS, FTP and rsync, and grows with plugins such as Docker, ZFS or backups through omv-extras.

title: XigmaNAS
summary: Creates a XigmaNAS virtual machine from the latest official ISO: a FreeBSD-based NAS with ZFS.
about: XigmaNAS, formerly NAS4Free, is a NAS system based on FreeBSD. It offers ZFS, software RAID and sharing over SMB, NFS, FTP and iSCSI from a lightweight web interface.

title: Rockstor
summary: Creates a Rockstor virtual machine from the official ISO: a Btrfs NAS based on openSUSE.
about: Rockstor is a NAS system built on openSUSE and the Btrfs file system. It manages pools, snapshots and shares over SMB and NFS from a web interface, and adds applications called Rock-ons.

title: FygoOS
summary: Creates a FygoOS virtual machine from the latest official ISO: a Debian-based NAS system.
about: FygoOS is a NAS system based on Debian, managed from a web interface, for storing and sharing files at home.

title: Umbrel OS
summary: Runs the Community Scripts installer of Umbrel OS, a home server system with an app store.

title: Windows (UUP Dump)
keywords: windows win10 win11 10 11 server uup dump iso
summary: Builds an up-to-date Windows ISO from Microsoft's servers with UUP Dump and creates a Windows virtual machine with it.
about: Windows is Microsoft's desktop and server operating system. UUP Dump downloads the Windows files from Microsoft's update servers and builds an installation ISO of the release, language and edition you choose, so the virtual machine starts from an up-to-date Windows.
notes: You choose the build on uupdump.net and paste its link; ProxMenux downloads the files and builds the ISO, which takes a while.
Windows needs its own license key to be activated.

title: Windows (ISO)
summary: Creates a Windows virtual machine from a Windows ISO already in your Proxmox storage.
about: Windows is Microsoft's desktop and server operating system. This option installs it from a Windows ISO you already uploaded to a Proxmox ISO storage, such as one downloaded from Microsoft.
notes: ProxMenux offers to download the latest VirtIO driver ISO or to use one you already have.
Windows needs its own license key to be activated.

title: Ubuntu
summary: Creates an Ubuntu virtual machine from the official ISO, desktop or server, of the release you choose.
about: Ubuntu is the Linux distribution by Canonical, released every six months with a long-term support (LTS) release every two years. The desktop edition comes with the GNOME desktop; the server edition installs without a graphical desktop.

title: Debian
keywords: debian netinst dvd trixie bookworm linux
summary: Creates a Debian virtual machine from the official ISO, full DVD or netinst, of the release you choose.
about: Debian is a community Linux distribution known for its stability, and the base of Ubuntu, Proxmox VE and many others. The DVD image includes a choice of desktops; netinst installs a minimal system and downloads the rest during the installation.

title: Fedora
summary: Creates a Fedora Workstation virtual machine from the official ISO of the release you choose.
about: Fedora Workstation is the desktop edition of Fedora, the community distribution sponsored by Red Hat. It ships recent software with the GNOME desktop.

title: Arch Linux
summary: Creates an Arch Linux virtual machine from the latest official ISO.
about: Arch Linux is a lightweight rolling-release distribution: it is updated continuously instead of by versions. The ISO starts a console from which the system is installed step by step, with only what you choose.

title: Rocky Linux

screenshots.author: The GNOME Project, Rocky Enterprise Software Foundation
The GNOME Project, Rocky Enterprise Software Foundation

summary: Creates a Rocky Linux virtual machine from the official ISO of the release you choose.
about: Rocky Linux is a community enterprise distribution compatible with Red Hat Enterprise Linux. It suits servers that need long-term support and stability.

title: Linux Mint
summary: Creates a Linux Mint virtual machine from the official ISO, with the Cinnamon or Xfce desktop.
about: Linux Mint is a desktop distribution based on Ubuntu, designed to be easy for people coming from Windows. Cinnamon is its main desktop, with a classic layout of start menu and taskbar; Xfce is lighter for smaller machines.

title: openSUSE

summary: Creates an openSUSE Leap virtual machine from the official ISO of the release you choose.
about: openSUSE Leap is the stable edition of openSUSE, built from the same sources as SUSE Linux Enterprise. Leap 16 installs with the Agama installer and is managed from the web with Cockpit.

title: Alpine Linux
summary: Creates an Alpine Linux virtual machine from the official ISO.
about: Alpine Linux is a small, security-focused distribution built on musl and BusyBox. The virt image is made for virtual machines and starts a minimal system that you set up with setup-alpine.

title: Kali Linux
summary: Creates a Kali Linux virtual machine from the official installer ISO.
about: Kali Linux is a Debian-based distribution for penetration testing and security audits, maintained by OffSec. It ships hundreds of security tools ready to use.

title: Manjaro

screenshots.author: Manjaro Linux: Roland Singer, Guillaume Benoit, Philip Müller u. a. * XFCE: André Miranda <gro.ecfx@mdlerdna> Alex

summary: Creates a Manjaro virtual machine with the GNOME desktop from the official ISO.
about: Manjaro is a desktop distribution based on Arch Linux that adds a graphical installer and tested updates, so recent software comes without building the system by hand.

title: AlmaLinux
keywords: almalinux alma rhel enterprise server linux
summary: Creates an AlmaLinux virtual machine from the official ISO, full DVD or minimal, of the release you choose.
about: AlmaLinux is a community enterprise distribution, binary compatible with Red Hat Enterprise Linux and run by the AlmaLinux OS Foundation. It suits servers that need long-term support and stability.

title: CentOS Stream
keywords: centos stream rhel enterprise server linux
summary: Creates a CentOS Stream virtual machine from the official ISO of the release you choose.
about: CentOS Stream is the distribution where the next minor release of Red Hat Enterprise Linux is developed, published by the CentOS Project. It gets RHEL changes before they are released, which makes it useful to test and build for the coming RHEL.

title: Oracle Linux
summary: Creates an Oracle Linux virtual machine from the official ISO of the release you choose.
about: Oracle Linux is Oracle's enterprise distribution, compatible with Red Hat Enterprise Linux. It is free to download and use, with optional paid support from Oracle.

title: Pop!_OS
keywords: popos pop os system76 cosmic desktop linux
summary: Creates a Pop!_OS virtual machine from the official ISO.
about: Pop!_OS is System76's desktop distribution based on Ubuntu, with its own COSMIC desktop and a focus on developers and creative work.

about: Zorin OS is a desktop distribution based on Ubuntu, designed to feel familiar to people coming from Windows or macOS. Core is the full edition; Lite is made for older or smaller machines.

title: CachyOS

summary: Creates a CachyOS virtual machine from the latest official ISO.
about: CachyOS is a desktop distribution based on Arch Linux and focused on performance, with a kernel and packages optimized for modern processors and a graphical installer.

title: NixOS
summary: Creates a NixOS virtual machine from the official ISO, graphical or minimal.
about: NixOS is a distribution built on the Nix package manager, where the whole system is described in one configuration file. Changes can be rolled back, and the same file rebuilds the same system on another machine.

about: Installs any Linux from an ISO you already uploaded to a Proxmox ISO storage: a distribution that is not in the list, a specific release or your own build. The virtual machine gets the same configuration as the official ISOs.

name: macOS (OSX-PROXMOX)
about: macOS is Apple's operating system. OSX-PROXMOX is a community project that prepares Proxmox VE and creates a macOS virtual machine on Intel or AMD processors.
notes: The installer changes the host configuration and reboots the server when it finishes.
Apple licenses macOS only for its own hardware.

title: ZimaOS
menu: Create VM from template or script
summary: Creates a ZimaOS virtual machine from the latest IceWhale image: a personal cloud and NAS system with an app store.
about: ZimaOS is the system by IceWhale, the makers of CasaOS and ZimaBoard. It turns a machine into a personal cloud and NAS, with a web dashboard, storage management and an app store.

title: Synology DSM
menu: Create VM from template or script
summary: Creates a Synology DSM virtual machine that boots through a loader (Arc, RR, Alpine M-shell or your own), with virtual disks or your physical disks.
about: DSM (DiskStation Manager) is the operating system of Synology NAS devices. On Proxmox VE it starts from a community loader that prepares the system disk, and DSM is then installed from Synology's own installer.
notes: Synology does not support DSM outside its own hardware; the loader is a community project.
